project.name: maven-embed-staging-ext/bnd-read
project.description: The bnd-header reading both sides of the embed staging need, vu d'en haut: the OSGi clause parser neither the JVM nor osgi.core provides (split on commas outside a quoted version range, package names, Import-Package mirrored as system exports) plus the embed Provide-Capability value (type=model/edge/seam, isDomain/isSeam, LDAP match). Input is a header STRING — each consumer reads the bytes itself with the JDK Manifest API. A flat jar: the runtime boot-discovery depends on it and embeds it on its own Bundle-ClassPath WITHOUT exporting it (bnd stays internal, never on boot-discovery's exported surface), and the core extension shades it. JDK plus osgi.core (for org.osgi.framework.Filter) only — no felix, no pax. Versions (osgi.core, JUnit) come from the BOM imported in build-parent; nothing pinned here.
